# MetaViewer
Linux desktop wall of browser and application capsules under human or agent control.
Ask first: python3 route/route_query.py any "<question>"
Read the returned section or span: python3 route/route_query.py show "<reference>"
Findings are leads; cited code proves a cause. Empty results mean not indexed, not absence.
Before editing, read AGENTS.md and LAWS.md. Check: python3 route/route_query.py check
Legacy catalogue: Status: router unavailable. Use route/. Query output labels byte coordinates explicitly.
Contributor editing protocol: AGENTS.md and catalogue/protocol.json.
